Summary of websites posted in 'general':
1) www.informations.com: Latest job report brought mixed relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.
2) www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the city center known for authentic Swiss cuisine (cheese fondue, rösti, chocolate fondue), with warm wooden interiors, panoramic skyline views and friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora! I visited your website. It's clean and simple, and having your contact email up front is handy. To improve it, you could add more about who you are and what you do, plus some visuals and clear navigation. Nice start!

Hi Eve! I enjoyed your blog. Sharing your love of hiking gives it a personal touch. To improve it, you could add posts with trail stories, photos, and tips, along with a clearer structure and categories. Great start!
